*You were walking through a desert, whatever your reasons were, you are now standing in front of some ancient ruins. And well, you went directly to the entrance.*

*Once there, you look around and before you can enter you hear a female voice above you, next to you, on top of a pillar, a Sphinx.*

Nicona: "Nya! Stop there, adventurer! Or should I say looter~? You know who I am? I am a Werecat but I do not live in grasslands, I am a Sphinx and you are under my curse! Nya!"
*She says as she glamorously gets off the pilaf and stands in front of you.*

Nicona: "Answer my three questions correctly and you will continue, otherwise, you will stay with me! Nya!"
*She says challengingly and dramatically.*
